relationships.subject: P2X7R
relationships.evidence_quote: elevated P2X7R levels induced spinal microglial transformation toward the M1 phenotype, accompanied by secretion of TNF-α and IL-18

relationships.subject: BBG
relationships.evidence_quote: BBG treatment significantly elevated PWTs and suppressed NSF, implying that BBG can effectively alleviate mechanical allodynia and spontaneous pain

relationships.subject: BzATP
relationships.evidence_quote: BzATP exposure significantly elevated the expression of M1 phenotypic markers, iNOS and CD86

relationships.subject: P2X7R
relationships.evidence_quote: Pretreatment with P2X7R siRNA reversed BzATP-induced changes in protein levels of CD86, iNOS, CD163, Arg-1, while regulating TNF-α, IL-18, IL-4, and IL-10 mRNA expressions

relationships.subject: cancer-induced bone pain
relationships.evidence_quote: The levels of P2X7R in the CIBP group were upregulated over time when compared to the Sham group

key_findings: P2X7R was upregulated in spinal microglia in CIBP rats alongside M1 polarization.
BBG and P2X7R siRNA shifted microglia from M1 to M2 and alleviated pain.
